name: search_archive
description: Semantic + visual search over every indexed camera (Cosmos Embed hybrid search on VAST). Use for any 'find / show me / when did' request. Returns numbered clips that appear on screen.

query.description: Visual description of the moment, e.g. 'white truck hits a barrier on the highway'

camera_id.description: Optional exact camera_id filter (get values from list_cameras)

location.description: Optional exact location filter (get values from list_cameras)

name: ask_archive
description: Ask a question and get a grounded answer from the VSS agent (searches captions, then writes an answer with evidence). Use for 'what happened / how many / was there' questions.

clip_id.description: Optional: restrict the answer to the parent video of this clip

name: list_cameras
description: List the filterable cameras, locations and capture types in the archive.

name: show_clip
description: Put a clip or a finished edit on the main screen (single view). For an edit, shows a before/after wipe slider over the original by default.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

edit_id.description: Edit id like "e1" to show the before/after comparison

style.description: For edits only: "slider" (drag-to-wipe before/after, default) or "split" (side by side).

name: look_closer
description: Ask NVIDIA Cosmos3-Reason a specific visual question about one clip (it watches the actual video). Use for details captions may miss: colours, plates, who hit whom, damage.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: detect_objects
description: Detect and track objects in a clip and draw labelled boxes on the video: YOLO11 for people and vehicles, plus NVIDIA Cosmos3-Reason grounding for forklifts, AGVs and robots in the warehouse and indoor sites. Returns counts and every tracked object with its id (e.g. 'forklift 1', 'person 2'), when it is on screen and how it moves. Use for 'how many', 'show me the cars', 'what objects are there'.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

labels.description: Optional comma-separated classes to draw, e.g. "truck, bus". Omit to draw every class.

name: show_detections
description: Change the bounding boxes on screen: show only some classes, show all again, or hide them.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

labels.description: Comma-separated classes to show, e.g. "person", "forklift", "car, truck". Use "all" to show every class.

visible.description: false hides the boxes. Defaults to true.

name: focus_object
description: Highlight one tracked object on the video with its path, dim the others, and play from when it first appears. Use for 'follow truck 2', 'which one is the bus'. Call detect_objects first if you do not know the ids.

object.description: Tracked object id with a digit, e.g. "truck 2" or "person 1". "none" clears the highlight.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: seek_clip
description: Jump the video on screen to a moment, paused by default so the user can look at that frame. Clips are about 5 seconds long.

time.description: Seconds from the start of the clip, e.g. 2.5

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

pause.description: false keeps it playing from that moment. Defaults to true.

name: summarize_video
description: Summarise the whole parent video a clip was cut from, as a timeline.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: edit_clip
description: Scrub a clip with a generative video model on fal (MiniMax H3, about 20 seconds; or Gemini Omni Flash). Removes, replaces, restyles or relights things while keeping the rest of the shot. Returns immediately with an edit id; a system notice arrives when it is ready, and it then appears as a before/after slider.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

instruction.description: What to change, concretely, e.g. 'remove the white truck and the debris; the lane is empty'

name: check_edit
description: Get the current status of an edit job.

name: verify_clip
description: Authenticity check. For an edit id: compares the edit with the original stored in VAST (SHA-256 fingerprints + Cosmos describing both) and reports exactly what was changed. For a clip: confirms it is untouched archive footage and lists any edits made from it.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: get_screen
description: Read exactly what the user is looking at right now: layout, clip, edit, boxes, zoom, notes, caption, timeline marks and cards. Call it when unsure what 'this' refers to.

name: compare_angles
description: Find the same moment from another camera of the same scene (warehouse and indoor multi-camera sims) and play both side by side in sync.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: set_layout
description: Change the viewer layout. 'grid' shows several clips at once, all playing (default: top four). 'compare' shows two named clips side by side in sync. 'single' goes back to one clip.

clips.description: Clip numbers, e.g. "1, 2, 5, 6" for a grid or "2, 4" to compare. Optional for grid.

title.description: Optional heading above a comparison, e.g. "Before vs after the shift change"

name: playback
description: Control playback of the main video: play, pause, restart, slow motion, or an exact speed.

speed.description: Optional playback rate, e.g. 0.25 for slow motion or 2 for double speed

name: zoom
description: Zoom the video in. With an object id the camera follows that tracked object as it moves (call detect_objects first). With a region it zooms on that part of the frame. region "reset" zooms back out.

region.description: center | top left | top right | bottom left | bottom right | left | right | top | bottom | reset

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: annotate
description: Pin a short callout on the video. With an object id the callout follows that object; otherwise it sits at a position. Use to point things out while you talk.

position.description: Optional: top left | top | top right | center | bottom left | bottom right

from.description: Optional: show from this second of the clip

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: set_caption
description: Show a one-line caption across the bottom of the video, like a news lower third. Empty text clears it.

text.description: One sentence, e.g. "Forklift 1 passes within a metre of person 2 at 3.1 s"

name: mark_moment
description: Drop a labelled marker on the clip's timeline under the video. The user can click it to jump there.

time.description: Seconds from the start of the clip

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: show_card
description: Generate a UI card on the board under the video to present findings visually. Every section is optional; combine what helps. Re-use replace to update a card instead of adding one.

stats.description: Big-number tiles as "Label: value; Label: value", e.g. "People: 3; Forklifts: 1; Closest: 0.8 m"

chart.description: Bar chart as "label=number, label=number", e.g. "person=3, forklift=1"

clips.description: Clip numbers to list as buttons and ring in the results reel, e.g. "2, 5"

moments.description: Clickable timeline as "seconds label | seconds label", e.g. "1.2 forklift enters | 3.1 closest pass" (for clip_id)

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

replace.description: Optional card id to update, e.g. "card 1"

name: clear_screen
description: Remove things from the screen: cards, notes, caption, marks, zoom, boxes, layout, a single card like "card 2", or all.

what.description: cards | notes | caption | marks | zoom | boxes | layout | card <n> | all
